notes.title: Pale Abyss - Official Soundtrack is available on YouTube!
notes.content:
[h2]You can now listen to the Official Soundtrack of Pale Abyss anywhere you want![/h2]
Since the reception of our game since release has been so amazing and a lot of people loved our Soundtrack, our talented musician at Permanent Crab Studios uploaded the official soundtrack for everyone to listen to on YouTube! You can now listen to all the beautiful in-game tracks at home, on the go, or anywhere you want really.

You can check out the full playlist [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL9bze0Nn0B1OTXyM2r3BzDPEGi6u7z5eg&si=m4CkNMzfug1rNQvU]HERE[/url]!

notes.title: Pale Abyss is available to download NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Pale Abyss is now available on Steam![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459207/80e8ccfa97aeb04359f661bc3e2ac9e699de61f9.png[/img]

It's finally here! Pale Abyss is now officially available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451290/Pale_Abyss/#game_area_purchase]Steam to download[/url] and play! We hope you'll enjoy your adventures in the Pale Abyss.

Please let us know what you think of our game and join us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Ww7G6P68EE]Community Discord[/url]!
